svg.title: Observed poor judgment is distinguished from an unproven lie
svg.desc: Separate observed judgment failure from unestablished deliberate deception. A question mark on intent prevents critique from silently escalating into a lie allegation.

**Frame:** A fork separates `POOR JUDGMENT / PERSPECTIVE ADOPTION — OBSERVED` from `DELIBERATE LIE — NOT ESTABLISHED`.

**Caption:**
> MISLEADING ANALYSIS DOES NOT, BY ITSELF, PROVE INTENT TO MISLEAD.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — METR saw no specific case of analysis-agent lying and was not confident it would detect one.

", "title": "Observed poor judgment is distinguished from an unproven lie" } }
